title: Eager relay connection on app load
observed_behavior_before: web/src/routes/+layout.svelte called initializeAuth() first and only invoked loadAll() from the auth promise finally handler.
Relay discovery and nostr.connect() were reached through loadAll() / bootstrapControlplane() after auth initialization had settled.
intended_behavior: App layout starts auth initialization and public relay discovery/connection in parallel during the first client microtask after layout mount.
The eager relay path reuses the existing Nostr-native discovery flow and starts nostr.connect() before authenticated control-plane bootstrap.
Control-plane bootstrap runs after auth and eager relay discovery settle, allowing it to reuse cached system discovery and pre-established SimplePool relay connections.
Concurrent connect attempts for the same relay set share the in-flight SimplePool connection attempt instead of opening duplicate handshakes.

excluded: controlplane.svelte.js streaming architecture changes are owned by bahia-ef15.
client.js module splitting is owned by bahia-rbqz.
